audit.whatIsWrong: The packet flagged no cooldown-sequencing advice, and the single most exploitable cooldown rule in Olaf's kit was nowhere in the entry: Undertow's cooldown is refunded when he picks the axe back up.
audit.why: Undertow is a flat 9s at every rank, but "If Olaf picks up the axe, the ability's cooldown is reset". That turns the whole lane into a positional game rather than a timing game — the punish window only exists while he is separated from the thrown axe. Telling a Zac player to "avoid the axes" without telling them to walk Olaf away from the axe hides the actual counterplay.
audit.corrected: Undertow is 9s flat, but picking the axe up resets it — walk him off the axe and that is your window.

audit.whatIsWrong: Ragnarok was written as blanket, unconditional immunity — "immune to your entire kit", "unstoppable".
audit.why: Riot's own text is "He can activate this ability to become immune to disables for as long as he keeps attacking." The conditional clause is the counterplay and it was cut. An Olaf with nothing in range loses the immunity, which is why disengaging beats standing and eating it. Written as unconditional, the advice reduces to "do nothing for the duration", which is both wrong and unactionable. Ragnarok is also 100/90/80s — the longest cooldown in the matchup and never once quantified.
audit.corrected: Immune to disables for as long as he keeps attacking; 100s at rank 1.

audit.whatIsWrong: Unstable Matter is repeatedly treated as a defensive layer — "melts you through your W Unstable Matter shield-tank stats", "attack speed that eats through your W Unstable Matter".
audit.why: Unstable Matter is a 350-range point-blank burst dealing a percentage of the target's max health. It is offence with a flat 5s cooldown and provides no shield, no mitigation and no resistances. Describing it as the thing Olaf's damage "eats through" gives the player a false sense of what is keeping them alive.
audit.corrected: W is Zac's %max-health damage, not his defence.

audit.whatIsWrong: Berserker Rage was described only as "attack speed", and Undertow only as a slow.
audit.why: Berserker Rage scales Attack Speed AND Life Steal off Olaf's MISSING health, so a grind against Zac makes him stronger the longer it runs — that is the mechanical reason extended trades are unwinnable rather than merely bad. Undertow also reduces Armor, not just Move Speed, so it front-loads his Reckless Swing follow-up.
audit.corrected: Berserker Rage pays out on missing health; Undertow cuts armour as well as speed.

audit.whatIsWrong: The late-game line says Olaf "can't cleanse past a Zac frontline".
audit.why: Nothing in Olaf's kit cleanses in the summoner-spell sense; Ragnarok grants immunity to disables, which is a different mechanic. The accurate point is that immunity to crowd control does not remove Zac's body from the path — a tank standing in the way still costs Olaf the time he needs.
audit.corrected: Ragnarok answers your CC, not your body-block.

audit.why: Content win[] reads Olaf x6 then Zac against 41.22% over 131 games. A lane Zac loses this hard, that only turns once teamfights start, is exactly what a 41% record with a late reversal looks like. No change.

edits.after: Olaf dominates: Undertow slows you and cuts your armour, and picking the axe back up resets its cooldown outright, so Reckless Swing true damage plus Berserker Rage attack speed melts your tank stats.

edits.after: Ragnarok makes Olaf immune to disables for as long as he keeps attacking, so your knockups whiff while he has a target in reach — deny him one and it lapses. 100s at rank 1.

notes: Packet suspectName 'Let's Bounce' is a FALSE POSITIVE — disk already reads "Let's Bounce!"; the detector strips the exclamation mark. No wrong ability names in this matchup. This is one of the two weakest matchups in the slice (41.22%) and it was carrying three separate mechanical errors, so it got the deepest pass: Ragnarok's conditional clause, Undertow's cooldown refund on pickup, and Unstable Matter being described as a defensive stat. UNVERIFIED, deliberately left alone: whether Ragnarok's immunity to disables also covers displacement specifically (knockups) is not stated in the kit file and Zac's needsResearch block is empty, which means unknown rather than no. The existing text asserts full immunity to Zac's knockups and I neither strengthened nor removed that claim — it needs a League Wiki check before anyone leans on it. SYSTEMIC: content win[] (Olaf x6, Zac) and full phases[].side (Olaf, Olaf, Olaf, Skill, Olaf, Skill, Olaf) disagree, and the full layer additionally hands Olaf the 2+ items stage while the content hands it to Zac. phases[].side is not repairable through apply-proposals.js, which rejects full-layer edits whose `before` is under 12 characters.
